start: An owner on Import members with an Excel file that has members, their plan dates and a paid column

steps.action: Choose the file and check the columns
user_sees: A card 'Plans and payments': '{n} members come with their plan and its dates ({k} plan names), and ₹{amount} already paid as receipts. Expiry reminders work for them from day one.'
must_not: A money figure shown before it is worked out as if it were final
A figure bigger than the receipts the import will make

user_sees: The result names the same number of receipts and the same money as the card said
must_not: More or less money saved than the card said
The preview itself having saved anything before Add

user_sees: Receipts of the import adding up to the same amount
must_not: A total that differs from the card

start: An owner on Import members with awkward files

steps.action: Choose a payments list that keeps a running 'paid so far' for one member: 2,000, then 4,500
user_sees: The card says ₹4,500 already paid as receipts

steps.action: Choose a file where one row is copied twice, and one whose plan and dates are already in the gym
user_sees: Money counted once for the copied row; nothing for the plan already here
must_not: Money promised for a plan that will be skipped

steps.action: Choose a file the import will refuse (a mobile number twice among the new members)
user_sees: The card names the members and plans but leaves the money out; tapping Add says why
must_not: A crash or a card that never appears

steps.action: Choose a file with plan dates and no paid amounts
user_sees: The card with no money words at all

start: An owner who already imported a file with payments

user_sees: No money promised: every plan and payment is already here
must_not: The same receipts promised a second time
A second set of receipts saved on Add

steps.action: Tap 'Undo this import', confirm, then choose the file again
user_sees: The card shows the money again, as the first time
must_not: Zero because receipts of the undone import are still counted

steps.action: Change a column choice on the page
user_sees: The money line worked out again for the new columns
must_not: The old figure left on the card

start: An owner looking at the card and then leaving without tapping Add

steps.action: Choose a file, read the card, close the page
user_sees: The gym exactly as before: no new member, plan or receipt
must_not: Anything from the file saved in the gym or sent anywhere just to work out the figure
A member or receipt marked as a preview left in the gym
